description.value: Momiji Garden is a Japanese-style garden located within Hastings Park in Vancouver, offering a tranquil green space amid the larger park complex. The garden is a publicly accessible attraction named in the tradition of Japanese maple gardens. Touring cyclists passing through the area may find it a worthwhile stop for a quiet rest.
